destinations.name: Islamabad
destinations.description: The modern capital of Pakistan, set against the scenic Margalla Hills, known for wide tree-lined avenues and iconic architecture.

places.name: Faisal Mosque
places.description: One of the largest mosques in the world, with a striking contemporary design resembling a desert Bedouin tent.
places.funFact: Designed by Turkish architect Vedat Dalokay; can hold tens of thousands of worshippers.

places.name: Daman-e-Koh
places.description: A hillside garden offering a panoramic view of Islamabad from the Margalla Hills.
places.funFact: The name means skirt of the mountain in Urdu and Persian.

places.name: Pakistan Monument
places.description: A national monument and heritage museum representing Pakistan's provinces and territories through petal-shaped structures.
places.funFact: Shaped like a blooming flower with petals representing the federating units.

places.name: Margalla Hills
places.description: A scenic mountain range surrounding Islamabad offering numerous hiking trails and nature walks.
places.funFact: Part of the Himalayan foothills with extensive trail networks.

places.name: Lok Virsa Museum
places.description: A museum dedicated to preserving the cultural heritage and folk traditions of Pakistan.
places.funFact: Showcases traditional crafts, textiles, and artifacts from across the country.

places.name: Rawal Lake
places.description: An artificial lake surrounded by green hills, popular for picnics, boating, and evening walks.
places.funFact: Part of Margalla Hills National Park's southern edge.

places.name: Saidpur Village
places.description: A historic village within Islamabad known for traditional architecture, cafés, and artisan shops.
places.funFact: Revitalized heritage village at the foot of the Margallas.

destinations.name: Lahore
destinations.description: The cultural heart of Pakistan, home to Mughal-era monuments, vibrant bazaars, and rich food heritage.

places.name: Badshahi Mosque
places.description: One of the world's largest mosques, built in the Mughal era, with a stunning red sandstone façade.
places.funFact: Among the most iconic landmarks of the Mughal period in Lahore.

places.name: Lahore Fort
places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage citadel with palaces, gardens, and monuments spanning several Mughal dynasties.
places.funFact: Contains the famous Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors).

places.name: Minar-e-Pakistan
places.description: A towering minaret in Iqbal Park commemorating the Lahore Resolution of 1940.
places.funFact: Stands where the All-India Muslim League passed the Pakistan Resolution.

places.name: Walled City of Lahore
places.description: The ancient fortified core with narrow bazaars, havelis, and centuries-old architecture.
places.funFact: Delhi Gate and other historic gates still mark old entrances.

places.name: Data Darbar
places.description: A major Sufi shrine complex and spiritual centre in the heart of Lahore.
places.funFact: One of South Asia's most visited shrines.

places.name: Androon Lahore
places.description: The old inner city lanes famous for street food, spice markets, and traditional life.
places.funFact: Best explored on foot early morning or evening.

places.name: Lahore Museum
places.description: A major museum with Gandhara sculpture, Mughal miniatures, and colonial-era galleries.
places.funFact: Houses the famous Fasting Buddha sculpture.

places.name: Racecourse Park
places.description: A large urban park with lawns, walking paths, and open green space.
places.funFact: Popular with families for picnics and jogging.

destinations.name: Murree
destinations.description: A popular hill station near Islamabad, beloved for pine forests, viewpoints, and cool summers.

places.name: Patriata (New Murree)
places.description: Chairlift and cable car with sweeping views of the Pir Panjal range.
places.funFact: Among the best-known cable car experiences near Islamabad.

places.name: Kashmir Point
places.description: A panoramic viewpoint with views toward the Kashmir hills.
places.funFact: Classic Murree sunset spot.

places.name: Pindi Point
places.description: Overlook with expansive views toward Rawalpindi and the foothills.
places.funFact: Named for its sightline toward Pindi.

places.name: Christ Church
places.description: A historic church reflecting colonial-era Murree architecture.
places.funFact: One of the town's heritage landmarks on the Mall.

destinations.name: Swat Valley
destinations.description: Often called the Switzerland of Pakistan—rivers, forests, alpine meadows, and adventure gateways.

places.name: Kalam Valley
places.description: A high-altitude valley with forests, rivers, and gateway treks to alpine lakes.
places.funFact: Base for trips toward Mahodand and beyond.

places.name: Malam Jabba
places.description: Pakistan's best-known ski hill area with resort facilities and summer hiking.
places.funFact: Popular year-round for mountain scenery.

places.name: Mahodand Lake
places.description: A pristine alpine lake surrounded by peaks—iconic Swat scenery.
places.funFact: Reached by jeep track from Kalam in season.

places.name: Saidu Swat Museum
places.description: Museum preserving Gandhara and regional heritage.
places.funFact: Highlights Swat's ancient Buddhist history.

destinations.name: Kaghan Valley
destinations.description: Famed for Lake Saif-ul-Malook, river scenery, and the Babusar route toward Gilgit-Baltistan.

places.name: Lake Saif-ul-Malook
places.description: A legendary alpine lake ringed by peaks, accessible by jeep or trek.
places.funFact: Tied to folk tales of a prince and fairy.

places.name: Babusar Top
places.description: A high pass connecting Kaghan with Chilas—dramatic mountain vistas.
places.funFact: Seasonal road; check conditions before travel.

destinations.name: Chitral
destinations.description: Remote northern KPK, home to the Kalash valleys and dramatic Hindu Kush scenery.

places.name: Kalash Valleys
places.description: Bumburet, Rumbur, and Birir—centres of Kalash culture and seasonal festivals.
places.funFact: Best known for Chilam Joshi and other cultural events.

destinations.name: Hunza
destinations.description: Legendary Karakoram valley views, forts, and high-altitude lakes.

places.name: Attabad Lake
places.description: Turquoise lake formed by a landslide dam—boating and photography hotspot.
places.funFact: Created in 2010; now a signature Hunza sight.

places.name: Baltit Fort
places.description: Historic fort above Karimabad with valley panoramas.
places.funFact: Restored as a museum and viewpoint.

places.name: Passu Cones
places.description: Jagged spires above Passu—among Pakistan's most photographed peaks.
places.funFact: Classic stop on the Karakoram Highway.

places.name: Hopar Valley
places.description: Side valley off Nagar with glaciers and quiet trekking.
places.funFact: Often spelled Hopper on older maps.

places.name: Karakoram Highway
places.description: The KKH through Hunza—one of the world's great mountain drives.
places.funFact: Engineering marvel linking Pakistan to China at Khunjerab.

destinations.name: Skardu
destinations.description: Gateway to Deosai, Shigar, and the high Karakoram—lakes, forts, and dramatic peaks.

places.name: Deosai National Park
places.description: Vast high plateau known for brown bears, wildflowers, and open skies.
places.funFact: Name linked to 'Land of Giants' in local lore.

places.name: Shangrila Resort (Lower Kachura Lake)
places.description: Iconic resort on Lower Kachura Lake—boat rides and mountain reflections.
places.funFact: Famous postcard view of Skardu.

places.name: Satpara Lake
places.description: Large reservoir near Skardu with dam views and boating.
places.funFact: Supplies water and power to the Skardu region.

places.name: Shigar Fort
places.description: Restored fort-palace heritage hotel and museum in the Shigar valley.
places.funFact: Showcases Balti architecture and royal history.

destinations.name: Diamer
destinations.description: Nanga Parbat foothills—Fairy Meadows is Pakistan's most famous meadow viewpoint.

places.name: Fairy Meadows
places.description: Alpine meadow with Nanga Parbat rising behind—trekkers' dream vista.
places.funFact: Jeep track plus hike; plan with local guides.

destinations.name: Neelum Valley
destinations.description: River valley in Azad Kashmir—villages, treks, and high lakes.

places.name: Arang Kel
places.description: Meadow village above Kel—chairlift or hike access in season.
places.funFact: Known for log-cabin style guesthouses.

places.name: Ratti Gali Lake
places.description: High glacial lake trek from Dowarian side.
places.funFact: Best in mid-summer when snow recedes.

places.name: Sharda
places.description: Riverside town with ancient Sharda temple ruins and trekking access.
places.funFact: Historic learning centre along the Neelum.

destinations.name: Muzaffarabad
destinations.description: Capital of AJK at the confluence of rivers—hill viewpoints nearby.

places.name: Pir Chinasi
places.description: Ridge viewpoint above Muzaffarabad with meadows and paragliding.
places.funFact: Popular day trip from the city.

destinations.name: Karachi
destinations.description: Pakistan's largest coastal metropolis—museums, monuments, and seafront life.

places.name: Clifton Beach
places.description: Popular seafront promenade along the Arabian Sea.
places.funFact: Evening camel rides and street food are classic experiences.

places.name: Mazar-e-Quaid
places.description: White marble mausoleum of Muhammad Ali Jinnah.
places.funFact: Landmark of modern Pakistan in the city centre.

places.name: Port Grand
places.description: Waterfront dining and entertainment complex.
places.funFact: Evening views over the harbour.

places.name: National Museum of Pakistan
places.description: Major national collections from Indus to modern eras.
places.funFact: Core stop for understanding Pakistan's layered history.
